content_warning: FICTIONAL. The deadline, the shared identity service, the application change and every number here were invented for rehearsal. Not a University of Iowa finding, not a statement about University capacity, and not a commitment to any date.

deadline.label: Fictional research-administration reporting submission
deadline.date_basis: kickoff + 8 weeks; expressed relative to kickoff, never as a calendar appointment
deadline.note: A fixed external reporting obligation. The window around it is where all the contention sits.

dependencies.label: Shared identity service (fictional)
dependencies.note: The reporting path authenticates through a service RIS does not control. Its change-freeze practice has never been asked for.

dependencies.label: Scheduled application change (fictional)
dependencies.note: A planned change to the reporting application lands close to the window.

assumptions.statement: effort to implement the scheduled application change
coordination wait on the shared identity service's change-freeze window
analyst capacity available inside the reporting window
effort to rehearse and stage a rollback before the window
unplanned recovery effort if the change misbehaves inside the window
temporary analyst capacity obtainable for the window
assumptions.stated_by: working figure; nobody has confirmed funding or availability

assumptions.statement: coordination effort to defer the scheduled change by one cycle

options.label: Proceed with the application change as scheduled
options.description: Do the change in its planned slot and absorb whatever it costs inside the reporting window.
not_modelled: the cost of the change itself slipping if the identity freeze turns out to be long

options.label: Defer the application change until after the reporting deadline
options.description: Move the change one cycle. The reporting window sees only the coordination cost.
not_modelled: the business cost of running the current application version for another cycle
whether anything downstream depends on the change landing in its original slot

options.label: Proceed, with a rehearsed rollback staged before the window
options.description: Pay a known rehearsal cost up front so an in-window failure is a rollback rather than an unplanned recovery.
not_modelled: whether a rollback is actually possible once the reporting run has started

options.label: Proceed, and add temporary analyst capacity to the window
options.description: Leave the change where it is and widen the window's capacity instead.
not_modelled: the ramp-up cost of a temporary analyst who does not know the reporting process
